item.title: CamWallet v2: Benefit Payments on a Closed Ledger
item.description: How CamWallet v2 lets government schemes pay beneficiaries and merchants in real time without a bank integration, why a double-entry ledger makes it auditable, and what building it with an AI agent loop taught me.

item.title: ESB-MOT: Building Online Tourism Licensing for Cambodia
item.description: What I learned building the Ministry of Tourism’s online licensing platform at TSC: what it changes for businesses and the ministry, how one licence moves through five services, and where the bugs actually came from.
